summary: The overhaul (decisions 0043 to 0066): neutral surfaces with one accent, floating panels instead of sheets from an edge, pages, the placement ladder, brand dials, the website kit, data at scale and desktop anatomy. Every 1.0.0 class, token, attribute and S4 function still works (the public API only grew), so there is nothing to rename; what changed is how an app should look and behave, so each item below is a review.

judgment.title: A seed colors only the accents
judgment.what: Surfaces stay neutral gray; the seed colors the main action, selection, switches and focus. Remove any app CSS that tints backgrounds, cards or bars by hand; for the everything-colored look use S4.theme({ seed, surfaces: 'tinted' }) (decision 0052).

judgment.title: Sheets are floating glass panels that pop
judgment.what: Nothing slides from a screen edge or docks. A .s4-sheet keeps its markup and now floats; remove app CSS that positions it against an edge. A tool panel for the page behind (filters, an inspector) takes data-modeless (decision 0054).

judgment.title: In place first, a dialog last
judgment.what: New content goes in place (.s4-expand, inline .s4-confirm), then a menu, a pane, a floating panel; a dialog only when the app cannot go on without an answer. Do, then offer Undo, instead of asking "Are you sure?".

judgment.title: No script puts the cursor in a field
judgment.what: Remove autofocus and any .focus() on a text field, textarea or select when something opens or after a validation error. Only the person's own tap does (a palette opened by their own shortcut is the one exception, decision 0067).

judgment.title: Reading is a page, never a dialog
judgment.what: Going into one thing (a record, an article, a setting) is a page: .s4-subpage with data-page-open, Back in the bar, a title and an address #view/page/id.

judgment.title: States, forms and direct manipulation are part of the language
judgment.what: Every list and pane has loading, empty, error and offline states (.s4-states); forms show errors on blur and autosave with Undo (.s4-form); drag, swipe and select-several are never the only way to do a thing.

judgment.title: Concentric corners; glass only for what floats
judgment.what: Nested corners: inner radius = outer radius minus the gap, or a full pill. A toolbar in the page flow is a solid joined button group, not glass. Never re-insert or animate an element under the finger.

judgment.title: The look changes only through the brand dials
judgment.what: Corners, gray temperature, page tone, typefaces, density and icon set are attributes set by S4.theme (data-corners, data-gray, data-page, data-type-display, data-type-text...). Replace app CSS that changes radii, fonts or grays for the whole app with the dial; controls read --s4-shape-control, never corner-full.

judgment.title: A website is a document
judgment.what: A site is body.s4-site with no app shell, start-aligned, one accent per page, header solid then glass. From decision 0066 a site loads the site bundle (orion.site.min.css and .js, inter-site.woff2, icons-site.js).

judgment.title: Button groups or tabs
judgment.what: If it swaps what is on the screen it is tabs (every tab has a panel); if it changes a value or how the same thing is shown it is a button group (the Ink Track); if it narrows a collection it is chips.

judgment.title: Tables of data at scale
judgment.what: More than about 50 rows, or rows from data, is S4.table(el, opts).setRows(rows) with the identifying column data-pin; narrowing a collection is .s4-filter (state in the address, no Apply button); code is .s4-code.

judgment.title: Desktop apps write every action once
judgment.what: A desktop app declares its actions in S4.commands (menus, menu bar, shortcuts, data-cmd buttons and the palette read it); settings is a view, never a dialog.

judgment.title: A fixed brand links its brand file
judgment.what: An app with a fixed brand color writes brand.css once (node <skill>/scripts/brand.mjs --seed '#rrggbb' --out brand.css) and links it right after orion.css, and restores its theme with S4.theme.restore(key, brand, { only: ['mode'] }).

judgment.title: A dialog asks one question with named answers
judgment.what: A dialog only asks what the app cannot go on without (delete for good, leave unsaved work, a permission), with two or three named answers (Cancel tonal, a destructive answer tonal error); never one answer, never a form. On a phone it is a card at the bottom by itself; never position it by hand.

judgment.title: Back keeps your place; a status is a tint
judgment.what: Back restores the view's scroll and focuses what opened the page; no flow leaves focus on <body>. A status is a tint (only the state that needs action now is warm); figures are .s4-num.

judgment.title: Nothing is outlined
judgment.what: data-variant="outlined" still works on buttons and draws a filled button; pick the variant you mean (tonal, elevated or text) so the markup says what it shows.
